_what: Tests in working/scripts/regression_selftest.py that are KNOWN to fail on this tree. autoland.sh gate 3 refuses a failure NOT listed here, and refuses when a listed test starts PASSING until this file is updated deliberately. The runner's exit status alone cannot gate: it returns 1 for a baselined failure.
_max_skipped_why: Skips allowed before gate 3 refuses. Raised 0 -> 2 on 2026-09-08, deliberately, with the reasons: (1) nul_truncation SKIPs on this laptop because the engine returns no documents — the laptop engine's task launcher resolves to the desktop app's bundle and no pipeline runs here (Task 4); it used to XFAIL vacuously on that empty response; (2) engine_pid_not_name SKIPs because the harness's port-bound lookup (:5565) resolves a foreign engine while the benchmark's engine serves on the port in logs/engine.port. Both name their reason in the runner output. A SKIP is a path the suite did not run; a green run on fewer paths is a narrower claim (register entry 27), so more skips than this refuse — raise it deliberately, never by re-running until it passes; lower it back to 0 when the laptop engine runs pipelines again.

Same symptom class as the 'Task stuck in INITIALIZING' entries in logs/engine.log from the Aug-10 engine. The box's engine (Linux, docker) is unaffected — the 18-Aug export and the films runs read the env_probe path fine. Stays baselined until the laptop engine's task spawn is repaired; Advisor R3/Task 4c: not forced.
